description_en: Verifies the identity of a phone number owner by using two-factor authentication
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl mobile-2-meta-verify-intl --product-code MOBILE_2META --param-type normal --user-name '张0' --mobile 18600001234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Mobile2MetaVerifyIntl

parameters.help_en: The product code. Set this parameter to MOBILE_2META
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

normal: not encrypted
md5: MD5-encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密
md5：md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The name. Valid values:

If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the name in plaintext.
If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the name in ciphertext as a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
姓名：

paramType 传 normal 时：传入姓名明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入姓名密文（输入32位小写md5字符串）
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The phone number.

If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the phone number in plaintext.
If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the phone number in ciphertext as a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
手机号码。

当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
当paramType取值md5时，传入手机号码密文，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: mobile
